role: B. ordinary queued execution and owner Wish stock clocks from actual runs (all-five player-only worlds, no mobs; training is its own actual profile)

declared.setup: Player factions/positions/config and the closed declarative action arrays are declared. Existing cases are reused by name from tools/ability-fixtures/cases.mts; the three custom scenarios are declared with the same action shape.
declared.helpers: chargesAt/nextChargeAt/abilityCooldownMs/maxCharges/slotReadyAt are the actual shared helpers called over the clock values the actual world emitted; they are labelled as helper output next to the raw s.wishReadyAt/s.extra.wishFullAt.
declared.noInjection: No expected post-cast state is written: frames/hooks/events are copies of the actual run.

input.name: training-swarm-real-five-second-recast-replacement
input.domain: training/dummy birth and short-cooldown prerequisite; every50ms still executed, no train or time jump

cases.provenance: declared scenario, actual ordinary 50 ms execution
declared scenario (room leave call), actual ordinary 50 ms execution
declared scenario, actual ordinary 50 ms execution

openingLock.provenance: actual birth snapshot + declared config, relation derived

blazeStock.provenance: actual all-five frames + accepted-cast hook arguments; helpers are actual chargesAt/nextChargeAt over the observed clocks

teleportRefund.provenance: actual run: pending freeze is refunded by the arena teleport hook (clearAll)

betweenStepCancellation.provenance: actual removePlayer/clearFighter/cancelCast path called between ordinary steps by the room-leave call

training.provenance: actual training profile: training flag cuts the Wish cooldown to TRAINING_WISH_COOLDOWN_SECONDS

sourceClosure.method: static import/export + dynamic load/import literal graph from the entry list plus engine.mts profile installers

externalPackages.phaser: replaced by tools/wish-public-fixtures/stub-loader.mjs: a declared base class only (RaidScene declares extends Phaser.Scene at module evaluation); no game, scene, renderer, DOM or keyboard runs
externalPackages.@colyseus/sdk: imported by packages/client/src/net/connection.ts; only sendInput's room.send recorder path is exercised

declared.note: Inputs/projection/host recorders are declared. Actual outputs are the unchanged source's return values, emitted events, emitted clocks and packed batches. No expected post-cast state is injected.
declared.clocks: performance.now() is a declared deterministic clock; no wall-clock value is captured.
declared.specials: Numeric specials are tagged ({tag:'NaN'|'+Inf'|'-Inf'|'-0'|'absent'}); a plain null is only a genuinely optional/absent field, never a valid zero.
declared.rInput: RaidScene.prototype.castSlot is called on a plain declared receiver; no keyboard, DOM, scene, camera or pointer proof is claimed.
declared.wishFx: WishFx.prototype.play/update are called with declared graphics/host recorders; method-level only, not a scene render.
declared.perceive: perceive() runs over declared source-schema-shaped projection rows and real packed batches; human WishFx output is a separate corpus and is not claimed to equal perceive.
